sections.title: Passengers & Cargo
sections.note: Listed under the realm you deliver to, in the order you can do them. Passengers want you to obey the signs (speed limits, whistle signs, no sudden stops); cargo is lost when the train is hit. Most rewards are Force Gems, which are also in the Force Gems tracker.

items.name: Alfonzo
items.howTo: After the second climb of the Tower of Spirits, collect his letter at the Castle Town mailbox, pick him up in Hyrule Castle's rest room and drive him home.

items.name: Kenzo the bridge worker
items.area: Bridge Worker's Home to the Trading Post
items.howTo: Linebeck III sends you for him. Pick Kenzo up at the Bridge Worker's Home, the first stop in the east of the Snow Realm, and drive him to the Trading Post obeying every sign.
items.reward: The bridge to the Ocean Realm (paid with the Regal Ring)
items.notes: Main Quest step. If he's unhappy he gets off and you have to go back for him.

items.name: Carben
items.area: Papuchia Village to the Ocean Sanctuary
items.howTo: After bringing him down with the Song of Birds, drive him to the Ocean Sanctuary; Miniblins and a Big Blin board on the way.

items.name: Dovok, Whittleton's chief
items.howTo: Orca in Papuchia Village wants a burly, bearded husband: take Dovok from his hut at the north of Whittleton to her.

items.name: Mona
items.howTo: From her house on the west side of Castle Town to Bunnio at Rabbitland Rescue; talk to her again by the train.

items.name: Joe
items.area: Aboda Village to Beedle's Air Shop
items.howTo: From Aboda Village's station to Beedle's Air Shop: whistle to land the balloon, then stop beside it.

items.name: Teacher in disguise
items.howTo: The disguised man by Castle Town's station is Teacher, looking for Zelda. Depending on the day he asks for Aboda Village, Anouki Village or Papuchia Village, and later for a ride back or to another village.
items.reward: Rupees, more the happier he is
items.notes: From Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough only. He can be driven again; tick it after the first ride.

items.name: Noko
items.howTo: From the water at the west end of Anouki Village to the lake at Wellspring Station.
items.notes: Required for the Mega Ice that cools Goron Village.

items.name: Mega Ice for Kagoron
items.howTo: Buy Mega Ice from Noko at Wellspring Station with the freight car Kagoron lent you and hurry it to him in Goron Village before it melts.
items.reward: The lava in Goron Village cools

items.name: Mega Ice for the Goron's house
items.howTo: Reach the Goron at the east end of Goron Village with at least 10 units of Mega Ice.

items.name: Fish for Lucia
items.howTo: Buy fish from Niboshi in Papuchia Village and reach Lucia by the Castle Town fountain with at least 10.
items.notes: Fish spoil over time and attract Snurgles.

items.name: Cuccos for Harry
items.howTo: Two loads of five Cuccos (50 Rupees each) from the Cucco man in north-west Castle Town to Harry's pen in Aboda Village.

items.name: Goron Iron for Mash
items.howTo: Goron Iron from the Goron in west Goron Village to Mash in Whittleton, with at least 5 units left.

items.name: Kenzo to Anouki Village
items.howTo: Pick Kenzo up where he still stands by the Trading Post bridge and drive him to Yeko in Anouki Village to build the fence.
items.reward: Treasure; with the lumber, Yeko's Force Gem
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: possible as soon as Carben's duet is done.

items.name: Lumber for Yeko
items.howTo: Buy lumber in Whittleton (100 Rupees) and reach Yeko in Anouki Village with at least 15 logs.

items.name: Ferrus to Alfonzo
items.area: Snow Realm tracks to Aboda Village
items.howTo: After his letter, find Ferrus on the north-south tracks just south-east of the Snow Temple and drive him to Alfonzo's house in Aboda Village.

items.name: Vessel for Steem
items.area: Papuchia Village to the Snow Sanctuary
items.howTo: Buy the Wise One's Vessel (50 Rupees) in Papuchia Village and get it to Steem at the Snow Sanctuary without the train being hit once.

items.name: Goron to Anouki Village
items.howTo: The Goron near Goron Village's station wants to see snow.
items.reward: Force Gem: Goron visits Anouki Village

items.name: Kofu to Goron Village
items.howTo: Kofu, in Honcho's house, wants to see Goron Village.
items.reward: Force Gem: Kofu visits Goron Village

items.name: Goron child to Castle Town
items.howTo: The Goron Elder's grandson wants to meet Zelda in the big city: drive him to Castle Town and talk to him as he explores.
items.reward: Force Gem: Goron child in Castle Town

items.name: Mega Ice for Niboshi
items.howTo: At least 10 units of Mega Ice to Niboshi, the fish seller in Papuchia Village. Warp Gate B saves time.

items.name: Wadatsumi
items.howTo: Free him in the Pirate Hideout's shooting gallery and drive him home, beating the pirate ships and the Miniblins who board.

items.name: Cuccos for Rael
items.area: Castle Town to the Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: Five Cuccos from the Cucco man in Castle Town to Rael at the Sand Sanctuary.

items.name: Ferrus to the Ocean Temple
items.area: Fire Realm tracks to the Ocean Temple
items.howTo: After the Sand Temple and a visit to the Tower of Spirits, his letter puts him north of the Goron Target Range. Drive him to the Ocean Temple on the Ocean Floor.
items.reward: Force Gem: Ferrus on the Ocean Floor

items.name: Dark Ore for Linebeck
items.area: Dark Ore Mine to the Trading Post
items.howTo: Dark Ore (10 for 200 Rupees) from the Dark Ore Mine to Linebeck III at the Trading Post, with at least 5 units left: kill the cave's Rocktite first, then use Warp Gates H and G.
items.notes: Sunlight ruins it. Repeat deliveries pay a Treasure or Rupees.
